hooks.text: 用可视化编程逻辑连接器官并直接调试技能
hooks.excerpt: Use simple programming logic to build organ links. The skill building process is highly visualized and can be easily debugged.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 数百种器官还能突变出附加词缀
hooks.excerpt: The game includes hundreds of organs with different functions. Each organ can also be mutated to obtain additional affixes which can further generate more unpredictable changes.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 把未知生物的器官和基因铺成血肉逃生路
hooks.excerpt: The organs and genes of unknown creatures can be your power. Make good use of them and create yourself a path of flesh and blood.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
